WITH aylar AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT musteri_id, substr(tarih, 1, 7) as ay
    FROM siparisler
),
ay_numara AS (
    SELECT musteri_id, ay, CAST(ay AS INTEGER) as ay_num
    FROM aylar
),
ay_sirasi AS (
    SELECT 
        musteri_id,
        ay,
        ay_num,
        row_number() over (partition by musteri_id order by ay_num) as sirasi
    FROM ay_numara
),
aylari_kumulatif AS (
    SELECT 
        musteri_id,
        ay,
        ay_num,
        sirasi,
        sum(case when lag(sirasi) over (partition by musteri_id order by ay_num) = sirasi - 1 then 0 else 1 end)
        over (partition by musteri_id order by ay_num) as grup
    FROM ay_sirasi
),
grup_bilgileri AS (
    SELECT 
        musteri_id,
        grup,
        min(sirasi) as baslangic,
        max(sirasi) - min(sirasi) + 1 as uzunluk,
        min(ay) as baslangic_ay
    FROM aylari_kumulatif
    GROUP BY musteri_id, grup
    HAVING max(sirasi) - min(sirasi) >= 2  -- En az 3 ay
)
SELECT 
    m.ad,
    gb.uzunluk,
    gb.baslangic_ay
FROM grup_bilgileri gb
JOIN musteriler m ON gb.musteri_id = m.id
WHERE gb.uzunluk = (
    SELECT max(gb2.uzunluk) 
    FROM grup_bilgileri gb2 
    WHERE gb2.musteri_id = gb.musteri_id
)
ORDER BY gb.uzunluk DESC, m.ad ASC
